data.one_liner: Handler for Android App Links, iOS Universal Links, and custom URL schemes across mobile and desktop.
data.what_it_does: Allows your Flutter application to open via HTTPS URLs or custom schemes. It provides a stream of incoming links as well as the ability to fetch the initial link when the app launches from a cold state.
use_when: You need to handle deep links or web-to-app links on mobile or desktop platforms.
You want to listen to incoming link events using a stream.
avoid_when: Your app does not require external deep linking or custom URL handling.
strengths: Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Provides both a stream for active link events and a way to retrieve the initial link on cold start.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific configuration setup for each targeted platform.
Web support is limited to the very first call.
data.setup_notes: Requires platform-specific configuration for Android, iOS, Linux, macOS, and Windows as detailed in the plugin documentation.
